units.source_text: 三国时嵇康游洛西，暮宿华阳亭，引琴而弹。

en.t: During the Three Kingdoms period, Ji Kang traveled west of Luoyang, spent the night at Huayang Pavilion at dusk, and took up his qin to play.

units.source_text: 忽有客来，索琴弹《广陵散》，以授嵇康，声调绝伦，殊不传人。

en.t: Suddenly a visitor arrived, asked for the qin, and played Guangling San, teaching it to Ji Kang; its melody was unsurpassed, but it was never passed on to others.
This account appears in the Biography of Ji Kang in the Book of Jin.
